latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Voice Generator, enabling fast AI voiceover generation for videos.
- Upload TXT, DOCX, PDF, or MP4 files up to 200MB and receive a natural-sounding male English voiceover in 20–40 seconds.
- Designed for content creators, marketers, and educators to skip complex editing software and get instant, professional-quality results.
- Supports easy export to multiple formats including MP4, MOV, AVI, WEBM, MP3, and WAV.
- Includes backend API token management with automatic session creation and error handling for credits, file types, and rate limits.
